eyebrow: Four releases, no measured demand leader
h1: A mechanism-based edge, conditional on eligibility
room_line: MEMBURU PEMANGSA has the most defensible conditional Day 1 proposition, but its Dewasa 17+ constraint and the slate-wide absence of verified purchases keep confidence low.
coming_kick: Separate proposition from proof: genre, audience fit and campaign shape support testable expectations, not a demand ranking.
coming_caveat: The private baseline is reconciled at 2,783 admissions from 240 shows. The conflicting 2,731/239 block is quarantined, and no causal omission is inferred.
signal_note: Measured evidence covers public campaign signals and private holdover performance; the new-title comparison is a mechanism-based prediction, while eligibility and paid demand remain unresolved.

eligibility.basis: Public release listing only; absent from the captured SAMS public Coming surface and no explicit current owner or Programming confirmation is provided.

coming.meta: Aghniny Haque and Mandela Pictures–Oceanus Media Global: supported by Fatmah Nahdi, Surya Saputra and Kiki Narendra; written and directed by Ivander Tedjasukmana.
coming.logline: Hesti searches for her missing father in Desa Gringsing, where Fatimah’s spirit terrorizes residents and kills anyone who tries to leave.
coming.quality: Atmospheric promise, not a film verdict: first-look coverage praises the dark visual mood and virtual-production finish, but no readable independent critic or audience assessment of the completed film was captured.
coming.gold: Distinctive hook, uncertain conversion: mystery horror, Aghniny Haque and Indonesia’s claimed first horror feature using LED virtual production create a usable positioning angle, but none proves cinema demand.
coming.promo: Active conventional campaign: the film has released first-look, poster and trailer material, conducted a cast media visit, held special screenings and staged a September 18 press screening.
coming.social: Visible but shallow sampled chatter: ten recent TikTok results totaled 13,476 views, 205 likes, seven comments and eleven shares; most posts were event or promotional coverage, not demonstrated audience pull.
coming.demand: Ticket intent remains unproven: the official trailer capture has no reach or engagement metrics, and the social sample shows promotional visibility without presale, seat-fill, sold-out or attributable watch-intent evidence.
coming.risk: Gate risk outweighs content risk: external release preparation is evident, but SAMS eligibility is still missing or unverified and the bundle contains neither transactional demand nor independent completed-film quality evidence.
coming.bet: If SAMS confirms eligibility, opening admissions per show will trail comparable new Indonesian horror despite active promotion.
coming.nug: Indonesia’s claimed first horror feature using LED virtual production offers distinction, but ten sampled TikToks showed shallow interaction and no ticket intent.

lanes.read: Cursed-village mystery: Hesti searches for her missing father in Desa Gringsing, where Fatimah’s spirit terrorizes residents and kills anyone who tries to leave.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Multiple readable sources consistently describe Hesti’s search, the trapped village and Fatimah’s lethal haunting.
lanes.decision_consequence: The premise is clear and marketable as mystery-led supernatural horror, but premise clarity alone does not establish demand.

lanes.read: Recognizable lead and regional production: Aghniny Haque leads with Fatmah Nahdi, Surya Saputra and Kiki Narendra; Mandela Pictures and Oceanus Media Global are the principal production houses.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Readable reports directly identify the lead cast, writer-director Ivander Tedjasukmana and the Mandela Pictures–Oceanus Media Global collaboration.
lanes.decision_consequence: Aghniny Haque supplies the clearest commercial face, while the established supporting cast and regional production add credibility rather than proven draw.

lanes.read: Atmospheric promise, not a film verdict: first-look coverage praises the dark visual mood and virtual-production finish, but no readable independent critic or audience assessment of the completed film was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: One fetched editorial calls the first look tense and visually mature, while captured screening reports merely confirm screenings occurred without reporting an independent evaluation.
lanes.missing_fact: A readable independent review or attributable post-screening audience assessment of the completed film.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not upgrade the title for presumed quality; treat the visual concept as a watch point until Day 1 audience response or a credible review arrives.

lanes.read: Distinctive hook, uncertain conversion: mystery horror, Aghniny Haque and Indonesia’s claimed first horror feature using LED virtual production create a usable positioning angle, but none proves cinema demand.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Readable launch coverage repeatedly foregrounds the cast, cursed-village mystery and virtual-production novelty.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use the technology and mystery as differentiation if eligibility is confirmed, while withholding any demand-led confidence until transactional evidence appears.

lanes.read: Active conventional campaign: the film has released first-look, poster and trailer material, conducted a cast media visit, held special screenings and staged a September 18 press screening.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: ANTARA directly documented the cast media visit, while current reporting confirms special screenings and the press screening.
lanes.decision_consequence: Awareness support is active near release, but the room should evaluate its conversion rather than reward campaign volume itself.

lanes.read: Visible but shallow sampled chatter: ten recent TikTok results totaled 13,476 views, 205 likes, seven comments and eleven shares; most posts were event or promotional coverage, not demonstrated audience pull.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured ten-post sample peaked at 5,520 views for one post and contained very little comment or sharing activity overall.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat social as modest launch visibility, not a reason to assume broad interest or ticket intent.

lanes.read: Ticket intent remains unproven: the official trailer capture has no reach or engagement metrics, and the social sample shows promotional visibility without presale, seat-fill, sold-out or attributable watch-intent evidence.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured official-trailer record contains null views and likes with zero fetched comments; sampled TikTok engagement is sparse and non-transactional.
lanes.missing_fact: Verified advance-booking or seat-fill data, attributable watch-intent evidence, or comparable opening demand at SAMS.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep insufficient evidence and do not infer an ordinary exploration floor; require eligibility confirmation, then use Day 1 admissions per show as the first demand test.

lanes.read: Gate risk outweighs content risk: external release preparation is evident, but SAMS eligibility is still missing or unverified and the bundle contains neither transactional demand nor independent completed-film quality evidence.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Public coverage confirms a September 24 Indonesian release campaign, while the supplied title record says the film is absent from the captured SAMS Coming surface with no owner confirmation.
lanes.decision_consequence: The room should first obtain explicit Programming ownership and eligibility confirmation; until then, publicity must not be converted into a booking assumption.

ai_rating.source_confidence: HIGH — premise, identity, campaign and release evidence are consistent across readable sources.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: LOW — absent from the captured SAMS Coming surface with no Programming eligibility confirmation.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: LOW — no verified presale, seat-fill, sold-out or attributable watch-intent evidence.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: MEDIUM — active campaign, but 13,476 sampled TikTok views produced only 205 likes, 7 comments and 11 shares.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: HIGH — the eligibility gate and missing completed-film verdict outweigh the distinctive content angle.
ai_rating.actionability: LOW — confirm SAMS eligibility first; if eligible, Day 1 admissions per show becomes the first usable demand test.

eligibility.basis: The title is corroborated by the captured SAMS public Coming surface with is_approved=true, but that public surface is discovery evidence and not private booking, DCP, or final eligibility confirmation.

coming.meta: Achmad Megantara, Indah Permatasari / Sinemata Buana Kreasindo: Mathias Muchus and Elma Theana support; directed by Jastis Arimba.
coming.logline: An aimless Indonesian-Australian man falls for a pesantren leader’s devout daughter, placing love, family expectations and his rediscovery of faith in conflict.
coming.quality: Quality remains unproven: an early-screening attendee, Depok Mayor Supian Suri, rated it 9/10 and praised its emotional message, but no independent critic or representative audience verdict was captured.
coming.gold: Broad emotional proposition, uncertain urgency: romance, family conflict and spiritual rediscovery can reach beyond a narrow religious audience, but the bundle shows no distinctive demand catalyst.
coming.promo: Promotion is active but its scale is unclear: the production has generated cast-led coverage, a promotional event and an early screening, without captured evidence of a broad roadshow or major paid campaign.
coming.social: Weak relevant traction in a noisy sample: identifiable film posts recorded 885 views with 5 likes, 1,263 with 11 likes, and a BUY 1 GET 1 offer at 378 views with 3 likes; keyword spillover dominates.
coming.demand: Purchase demand is unverified: one post asks who has secured tickets and another advertises BUY 1 GET 1, but no first-party presale, seat-map, sold-out, sales-volume or SAMS booking evidence was captured.
coming.risk: Main risk is false confidence from promotional evidence: favorable prerelease coverage and a 9/10 political-figure quote coexist with weak relevant social traction and no verified purchase signal.
coming.bet: If eligible, it will open below comparable Indonesian new-release occupancy because purchase intent and relevant social traction are weak.
coming.nug: Broad emotional reach, limited urgency: romance, family conflict and rediscovery of faith widen the proposition, but no distinctive demand catalyst is captured.

lanes.read: An aimless Indonesian-Australian man falls for a pesantren leader’s devout daughter, forcing love, family expectations and his rediscovery of faith into conflict.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Multiple captured full texts consistently describe Rico, Santun, the pesantren setting, family pressure and Rico’s return to faith.
lanes.decision_consequence: Position it as an accessible romance-family drama with a religious journey, not as a purely devotional film.

lanes.read: Achmad Megantara and Indah Permatasari lead; Mathias Muchus and Elma Theana support. Sinemata Buana Kreasindo is the credited production banner.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured release coverage repeatedly names the lead cast, supporting cast, director Jastis Arimba and Sinemata Buana Kreasindo.
lanes.decision_consequence: The recognizable leads provide the clearest commercial hook, while the ensemble strengthens the family-drama positioning.

lanes.read: Quality remains unproven: an early-screening attendee, Depok Mayor Supian Suri, rated it 9/10 and praised its emotional message, but no independent critic or representative audience verdict was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Supian Suri watched an early screening and gave the film 9/10, citing its themes of love, family, loss and life’s trials.
lanes.missing_fact: An independent critic review or a representative post-screening audience response addressing execution, pacing and emotional payoff.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not use the favorable screening quote to justify extra sessions; treat quality as an opening-week watch variable.

lanes.read: Broad emotional proposition, uncertain urgency: romance, family conflict and spiritual rediscovery can reach beyond a narrow religious audience, but the bundle shows no distinctive demand catalyst.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured coverage consistently frames the film around romance, family, faith, loss and an Indonesian-Australian setting.
lanes.decision_consequence: Sell the emotional relationship conflict and recognizable leads, but keep the opening posture conservative until paid demand appears.

lanes.read: Promotion is active but its scale is unclear: the production has generated cast-led coverage, a promotional event and an early screening, without captured evidence of a broad roadshow or major paid campaign.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured coverage explicitly references a promotional event, while a separate report documents an early screening attended by Depok’s mayor.
lanes.decision_consequence: Credit the campaign with basic launch activity, but do not convert press volume into presumed audience reach.

lanes.read: Weak relevant traction in a noisy sample: identifiable film posts recorded 885 views with 5 likes, 1,263 with 11 likes, and a BUY 1 GET 1 offer at 378 views with 3 likes; keyword spillover dominates.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured ten-post TikTok keyword sample contains only a few clearly film-related posts, each with modest reach and interaction.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat social as a downside caution, not a demand forecast; the keyword is too ambiguous and the sample too small for representative measurement.

lanes.read: Purchase demand is unverified: one post asks who has secured tickets and another advertises BUY 1 GET 1, but no first-party presale, seat-map, sold-out, sales-volume or SAMS booking evidence was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The nearest purchase signals are two low-reach TikTok posts referring to tickets, including a BUY 1 GET 1 seller-style offer.
lanes.missing_fact: First-party cinema showtimes or presale data, paid admissions, seat-map movement, or confirmed SAMS booking and eligibility.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not promote the title from watch status to demand-backed confidence; require eligibility confirmation and use Day 1 paid occupancy as the first decisive test.

lanes.read: Main risk is false confidence from promotional evidence: favorable prerelease coverage and a 9/10 political-figure quote coexist with weak relevant social traction and no verified purchase signal.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured sources are predominantly promotional or informational, while the only measurable title-relevant social posts show modest interaction.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the title provisional and measurement-led; neither publicity volume nor the early-screening endorsement supports aggressive opening exposure.

ai_rating.source_confidence: Quality unproven: Depok Mayor Supian Suri rated it 9/10, but no independent critic or representative audience verdict was captured.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Eligibility unconfirmed: SAMS public Coming shows is_approved=true, but booking, DCP readiness and eligible sites lack owner confirmation.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Purchase demand unverified: ticket talk and a BUY 1 GET 1 post exist, but no presale, seat-map or paid-admission evidence.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Active but modest: cast-led press, a promo event and early screening; relevant TikToks reached 885, 1,263 and 378 views.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: High false-confidence risk: promotional coverage and a mayoral 9/10 coexist with weak relevant social traction and no verified purchases.
ai_rating.actionability: Observe and learn: confirm eligibility, then test paid occupancy against comparable Indonesian new releases on Day 1 and Day 4.

eligibility.basis: Public release listing only; absent from the captured SAMS public Coming surface and no explicit current owner or Programming confirmation is provided.

coming.meta: Marsha Timothy, Fara Shakila, Falcon Pictures: Herwin Novianto directs, with Praz Teguh and Ivan Gunawan.
coming.logline: A terminally ill single mother races to prepare her young daughter for an independent life after her death.
coming.quality: Quality remains unproven: captured reactions describe a tearful screening experience, but they come from a promotional social sample rather than independent reviews of execution.
coming.gold: Emotionally accessible family proposition: the universal mother-daughter loss theme, familiar stars and audience-participation campaign may support family co-viewing, but breadth beyond sentiment-led audiences is unproven.
coming.promo: Active thematic promotion: Falcon's social campaign turns personal stories about mothers into film participation, but no captured evidence establishes roadshow scale, paid reach or ticket conversion.
coming.social: Visible but narrow social response: the captured ten-post TikTok sample peaked at 25,338 views with 455 likes, 17 comments and 39 shares, while most sampled posts remained below 4,000 views.
coming.demand: Ticket demand is unproven: the 24 September nationwide release is repeatedly stated, but no captured presale, booking, seat-fill or purchase-intent evidence shows that awareness is converting.
coming.risk: Execution and conversion risk dominate: the proposition relies on familiar tearjerker material, social evidence is promotion-shaped, independent quality is absent and SAMS bookability remains unverified.
coming.bet: If screened at eligible SAMS sites, demand will concentrate in family-friendly sessions without broad all-day strength.
coming.nug: Distinctive participation hook: Falcon plans to place 100 audience-submitted photographs celebrating mothers in the film's ending.

lanes.read: A terminally ill single mother races to prepare her young daughter for an independent life after her death.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured IDN Times article directly describes the mother, her limited remaining life and her effort to prepare her daughter.
lanes.decision_consequence: The premise is clear and emotionally legible, so creative identity is not the reason to withhold judgment.

lanes.read: Recognizable domestic package: Falcon Pictures pairs Marsha Timothy and Fara Shakila under director Herwin Novianto, supported by Praz Teguh and Ivan Gunawan.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured IDN Times article directly identifies Falcon Pictures, the director and principal cast.
lanes.decision_consequence: The package supplies recognizable talent and a credible distributor-facing identity, but does not establish demand by itself.

lanes.read: Quality remains unproven: captured reactions describe a tearful screening experience, but they come from a promotional social sample rather than independent reviews of execution.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Several sampled TikTok posts claim audiences cried, including one post with 25,338 views, but the sample is campaign-shaped and not independently representative.
lanes.missing_fact: A readable independent review or verified non-promotional screening assessment addressing acting, pacing and emotional execution.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat the emotional promise as testable creative potential, not as evidence that the finished film works; do not enlarge a floor on quality claims.

lanes.read: Emotionally accessible family proposition: the universal mother-daughter loss theme, familiar stars and audience-participation campaign may support family co-viewing, but breadth beyond sentiment-led audiences is unproven.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Falcon invited people to share photographs and stories about their mothers, with 100 selected photographs intended for the film's ending.
lanes.decision_consequence: If eligibility is confirmed, test concentrated family-friendly sessions rather than assuming broad all-day demand.

lanes.read: Active thematic promotion: Falcon's social campaign turns personal stories about mothers into film participation, but no captured evidence establishes roadshow scale, paid reach or ticket conversion.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: ANTARA directly reports the social-media campaign and its planned use of 100 audience photographs in the film.
lanes.decision_consequence: Credit the title with an active and coherent campaign, while separating that activity from quality and sales evidence.

lanes.read: Visible but narrow social response: the captured ten-post TikTok sample peaked at 25,338 views with 455 likes, 17 comments and 39 shares, while most sampled posts remained below 4,000 views.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: One keyword-search sample captured ten recent posts; the leading post materially outperformed the rest, while comment volume remained limited.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use this as evidence of some emotional-content reach, not broad audience momentum or purchase intent.

lanes.read: Ticket demand is unproven: the 24 September nationwide release is repeatedly stated, but no captured presale, booking, seat-fill or purchase-intent evidence shows that awareness is converting.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: ANTARA confirms the intended cinema release date but contains no ticket-sales or advance-booking signal.
lanes.missing_fact: Current presale availability, booked-seat counts or another direct purchase-proximity measure tied to eligible SAMS markets.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep insufficient evidence and assign no ordinary exploration floor until SAMS eligibility is confirmed; if confirmed, begin conservatively and require early transactional evidence.

lanes.read: Execution and conversion risk dominate: the proposition relies on familiar tearjerker material, social evidence is promotion-shaped, independent quality is absent and SAMS bookability remains unverified.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The film is identified as a Wedding Dress remake, while the only captured audience-response evidence is a small directional TikTok sample.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not let recognizable talent or emotional reactions override the missing eligibility and transaction gates; confirmation must precede any floor.

ai_rating.source_confidence: Medium: premise, package, release and campaign are sourced; finished-film quality is not.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Low: absent from the captured SAMS Coming surface; current Programming eligibility is unconfirmed.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Low: 24 September is confirmed, but no presale, booked-seat or purchase-intent evidence was captured.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Medium-low: one TikTok reached 25,338 views, while most sampled posts remained below 4,000.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: High: eligibility, transaction evidence and independent quality are missing; reactions are promotion-shaped.
ai_rating.actionability: Low: confirm SAMS bookability, then observe Day 1 and Day 4 admits per show against the domestic median.

coming.meta: Laura Basuki, Prilly Latuconsina and Sinemaku Pictures: Taskya Namya and Yasamin Jasem co-star; directed by Umay Shahab.
coming.logline: Four female journalists investigating murdered and missing children confront a predator whose crimes appear entangled with supernatural forces.
coming.quality: Promising theatrical feel: a premiere report observed sustained tension, jump reactions and lighter moments, but this is event coverage rather than a rigorous independent quality verdict.
coming.gold: Commercial hook: recognizable actresses, horror-crime-action energy and a socially urgent child-protection theme create differentiation, while the 17+ rating and grim subject constrain breadth.
coming.promo: Active campaign: the film received an Umay Shahab–Laura Basuki media visit, official teaser materials and premiere screenings across seven cities; campaign activity is proven, effectiveness is not.
coming.social: Social signal unavailable: no title-level observations or calls were captured because the weekly five-call credit was already exhausted, so neither engagement nor sentiment can be judged.
coming.demand: Demand remains unproven: an aggregator displays September 24 showtimes and purchase routes, but supplies no presale, occupancy or sell-through evidence and contains an internal year inconsistency.
coming.risk: Risk signal: the Dewasa 17+ rating and explicit child-abduction, mutilation and exploitation material may narrow the audience and require careful positioning; current SAMS eligibility is also unresolved.
coming.bet: If carried by SAMS, Day 1 admissions per show will meet or exceed the same-site median for comparable new Indonesian 17+ horror.
coming.nug: A recognizable female ensemble brings investigative horror-action to a child-protection story, but its Dewasa 17+ severity narrows the proposition.

lanes.read: Four female journalists investigating murdered and missing children confront a predator whose crimes appear entangled with supernatural forces.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured synopsis directly describes Agnes joining three journalists and a police officer to investigate the child-abduction case.
lanes.decision_consequence: The premise is clear enough for Programming to position the film as investigative horror-action rather than generic supernatural horror.

lanes.read: Talent anchor: Laura Basuki and Prilly Latuconsina lead alongside Taskya Namya and Yasamin Jasem in a Sinemaku Pictures production directed by Umay Shahab.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A captured film profile names the four leads, director Umay Shahab and Sinemaku Pictures.
lanes.decision_consequence: The recognizable female ensemble gives the room a credible marketing hook, but star recognition alone should not determine screen allocation.

lanes.read: Promising theatrical feel: a premiere report observed sustained tension, jump reactions and lighter moments, but this is event coverage rather than a rigorous independent quality verdict.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Harian Jogja described audible audience reactions, tense horror-action passages and intermittent humor at a September 19 screening.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat the film as potentially audience-responsive, while withholding any quality-led allocation uplift until independent reviews or Day 1 behavior arrive.

lanes.read: Commercial hook: recognizable actresses, horror-crime-action energy and a socially urgent child-protection theme create differentiation, while the 17+ rating and grim subject constrain breadth.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured sources establish the ensemble, hybrid genre, child-protection premise and a Dewasa 17+ classification.
lanes.decision_consequence: Resolve SAMS eligibility promptly and, if carried, market the ensemble and investigative tension rather than relying on the disturbing subject alone.

lanes.read: Active campaign: the film received an Umay Shahab–Laura Basuki media visit, official teaser materials and premiere screenings across seven cities; campaign activity is proven, effectiveness is not.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Tempo documented the July 29 promotional visit, while Harian Jogja documented a seven-city premiere program.
lanes.decision_consequence: Programming can expect some launch awareness, but should not convert campaign presence into a demand assumption without sales evidence.

lanes.read: Social signal unavailable: no title-level observations or calls were captured because the weekly five-call credit was already exhausted, so neither engagement nor sentiment can be judged.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The bound social receipt records zero observations and zero attempts for this title, with all five weekly calls consumed elsewhere.
lanes.missing_fact: A direct, title-level sample of reach, engagement quality, sentiment and purchase-oriented comments.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not grant or remove screens on presumed social momentum; use verified booking or Day 1 behavior instead.

lanes.read: Demand remains unproven: an aggregator displays September 24 showtimes and purchase routes, but supplies no presale, occupancy or sell-through evidence and contains an internal year inconsistency.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: JadwalNonton displays specific Jakarta sessions, prices and cinema purchase links, but no sold-seat information.
lanes.missing_fact: Verified current presale volume, seat-map sell-through or SAMS-local booking velocity, plus explicit SAMS carriage confirmation.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep insufficient evidence and set no ordinary exploration floor; the public launch evidence justifies urgent eligibility confirmation, not allocation confidence.

lanes.read: Risk signal: the Dewasa 17+ rating and explicit child-abduction, mutilation and exploitation material may narrow the audience and require careful positioning; current SAMS eligibility is also unresolved.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured listings establish the 17+ rating and unusually severe child-harm subject matter.
lanes.decision_consequence: Avoid a blind opening commitment; first confirm SAMS eligibility, then manage the film as a targeted adult horror-action proposition with close Day 1 monitoring.

what_milo_sees.title: MEMBURU PEMANGSA
what_milo_sees.insight: If both are eligible under comparable conditions, MEMBURU PEMANGSA should lead IBADAH & CINTA on Day 1 admissions/show: investigative horror-crime and recognizable talent offer opening urgency, while its 17+ child-harm content limits reach. This is a low-confidence mechanism forecast, not measured demand.
what_milo_sees.room_question: Where both are eligible under comparable conditions, does MEMBURU PEMANGSA actually open above IBADAH & CINTA, and does its Dewasa 17+ constraint suppress the expected genre advantage?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: MEMBURU PEMANGSA exceeds IBADAH & CINTA in matched Day 1 admissions per show and meets or exceeds the same-site median for comparable new Indonesian 17+ horror.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: IBADAH & CINTA matches or exceeds it under matched conditions, or MEMBURU PEMANGSA trails the comparable 17+ horror median.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: Retain no demand leader; treat MEMBURU PEMANGSA as a low-confidence mechanism hypothesis and IBADAH & CINTA as an equally unproven alternative until paid observations exist.

public_signal_shape.comparison: Seven-city premieres and press activity are supported, but social reach and purchase conversion are unavailable; unavailable data do not imply weak response.

title_hypotheses.title: IBADAH & CINTA

title_hypotheses.title: MEMBURU PEMANGSA
